title: Tiếng Gõ Đêm Ba Giờ: Lời Nguyền Giếng Đá Ong
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese folk-horror film in a 150-year-old Northern Vietnamese ironwood ancestral house on a misty hillside; gritty grade with deep charcoal-black shadows, wet dark-ironwood browns and dark rust-terracotta tones, monsoon damp, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain.
lighting: Low-key horror lighting: flickering amber oil-lantern and candle light against cold cyan-green moonlight, white lightning flashes and midnight-blue shade; daylight stays muted and desaturated.

narrator.voice: Vietnamese man about 45, standard Hà Nội Northern accent with clear six tones, sharp resonant mid-baritone with crisp consonants, fast and fluent late-night ghost-story delivery in one continuous breath, every word spoken once and clearly, no stutter, no pauses mid-sentence, never slow or sleepy

@Lam.name: Lâm
@Lam.anchor: Lâm, 27, Vietnamese architecture photographer; lean, pale angular face, thin metal-rimmed glasses, neat parted black hair; dark olive-green field jacket over a charcoal-grey shirt, dark trousers, brown leather satchel across the chest. When he carries a light it is a brass kerosene storm lantern, never a flashlight.
@Lam.voice: man of 27, standard Hà Nội accent, clear baritone-tenor, tense and breathless, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace

@BaCam.name: Bà Cầm
@BaCam.anchor: Bà Cầm, 78, stooped caretaker of the house; deeply wrinkled grey face, silver hair in a low bun with a black ebony hairpin, cloudy milky-white blind left eye; dark earth-brown áo bà ba and black silk trousers; brass oil lamp, black oiled-paper umbrella, bronze key ring.
@BaCam.voice: old woman of 78, Northern accent, raspy low voice, ominous, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace

@CuTu.name: Cụ Từ
@CuTu.anchor: Cụ Từ, 85, the village temple keeper; gaunt stern face, long silver beard to the chest; black brocade robe and black folded khăn xếp turban; bronze hand bell, bamboo staff.
@CuTu.voice: old man of 85, Northern accent, deep commanding voice, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace

@CoUt.name: cô Út
@CoUt.anchor: the ghost of cô Út, 19; pale wet porcelain skin, long wet black hair clinging to her face, sorrowful dark eyes; soaked, mud-stained off-white silk áo dài, a rusted broken iron cuff on one wrist, barefoot.
@CoUt.voice: young woman of 19, Northern accent, soft clear voice with a wet, hollow echo, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace

scenes.title: Cổng Nhà Cổ Trong Mưa Ngâu & Ba Lời Thề Bên Giếng Đá Ong
scenes.time_label: 18:30 Chập tối tháng Bảy âm lịch (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Mossy laterite stone archway gate, rain-swept Bát Tràng brick courtyard with the chained laterite well, and dark ironwood veranda of the 150-year-old Vũ clan ancestral house.
scenes.axis: Axis from the mossy stone gate across the wet brick courtyard past the chained laterite well to the dimly lit three-bay ironwood veranda.
scenes.props: Mossy stone archway gate with iron bars, laterite stone well sealed with a red-inscribed stone slab and three rusted iron chains, black oiled-paper umbrella, bronze key ring, vintage contract paper and red ink pad.
scenes.setting: Rainy dusk in the seventh lunar month: the Vũ clan's ironwood house on a misty hillside — mossy laterite stone archway gate with iron bars, a wet brick courtyard with a laterite well sealed by a red-inscribed stone slab and three rusted iron chains, a dark three-bay ironwood veranda and worship hall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tháng Bảy mưa ngâu lạnh buốt, dân làng đồn rằng nhà cổ họ Vũ mang lời nguyền chết chóc không lối thoát.
clips.camera: 24mm stabilized aerial drone slow descending push-in
beats: Wide aerial view above the fog-shrouded ironwood roof and mossy stone gate with @Lam standing below.

High-angle aerial camera descending through dense 7th-lunar-month evening fog toward the isolated three-bay ironwood Vũ ancestral house; @Lam stands with his camera bag before the mossy laterite archway gate.
@Lam stands before the mossy stone archway gate looking into the dark courtyard as rain mist swirls.
clips.sfx: steady monsoon rain, cold wind whistling through old trees and the mossy stone gate

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Vì món thù lao hậu hĩnh, Hoàng Lâm vẫn liều lĩnh một mình tìm đến nhận trông ngôi nhà cổ ba đêm.
clips.camera: 28mm stabilized gimbal slow tracking follow shot
beats: @Lam steps through the mossy stone archway gate into the rain-slick brick courtyard.
@Lam steps across the rain-flooded stone threshold into the dark brick courtyard, stopping before the ancient laterite well sealed with a red-inscribed stone slab and three rusted iron chains.
@Lam halts near the chained laterite stone well in the courtyard, glancing toward the dark veranda.
clips.sfx: shoes splashing on wet bricks, iron chains ringing faintly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đón anh nơi hiên nhà lạnh toát là bà Cầm mù một mắt, bàn tay gầy guộc nắm chặt chùm chìa khóa đồng.
beats: @Lam looks toward the dark veranda as @BaCam steps out under her black oiled-paper umbrella.

From the shadowed ironwood veranda, @BaCam emerges holding a black oiled-paper umbrella and brass oil lamp, her milky-blind left eye staring unblinkingly at @Lam as she clutches a mud-smelling bronze key ring.
@BaCam stands on the porch steps holding the oil lamp and bronze keys, staring coldly at @Lam.
clips.sfx: slow footsteps on the wooden veranda, bronze keys jingling, rain on an oiled-paper umbrella

clips.speaker: @BaCam
clips.line: Đúng ba giờ sáng, dù dưới đáy giếng có tiếng khóc gọi tên, cậu tuyệt đối không được mở xích nhìn xuống!
beats: Medium close-up of @BaCam on the dim porch raising her bony hand toward the courtyard well.
@BaCam points a bony, trembling finger out at the chained laterite well in the rain and gives her warning, her face toward the camera.
@BaCam holds her finger pointed at the chained well, her blind eye gleaming in the lamplight.
clips.sfx: rain pounding the courtyard, wind whistling through gaps in the wood

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà dặn cấm soi gương đồng phủ lụa đen sau nửa đêm, nếu hành lang hiện cửa thứ tư phải lùi ngay.
beats: @BaCam leads @Lam across the threshold into the dark ironwood worship hall.
@BaCam leads @Lam inside the gloomy ironwood worship hall, pointing toward a tall bronze mirror draped in black silk and a narrow side corridor with only three wooden bedroom doors.
@Lam gazes from the black-draped bronze mirror toward the three-door corridor beside @BaCam.
clips.sfx: ironwood floorboards creaking, cold night wind through the door gaps

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm ấn ngón tay điểm chỉ đỏ thẫm lên giấy, chẳng ngờ cánh cổng sắt khép lại đã nhốt chặt anh vào bẫy.
beats: @Lam leans over the wooden table and presses his red-inked thumb onto the old contract paper.
@Lam lifts his thumb from the contract; when he looks up, @BaCam has vanished into the courtyard fog and the outer iron gate swings shut by itself.
@Lam snaps his head toward the empty doorway as the outer iron gate shuts in the fog.
clips.sfx: a thumb pressed on paper, then the iron gate outside slamming shut with a booming echo

scenes.title: Đêm Đầu Tiên — Đồng Hồ Dừng Lúc 2 Giờ 59 Phút & Tiếng Gõ Dưới Đáy Giếng
scenes.location: Dark ironwood ancestral main hall with an antique pendulum clock frozen at 02:59, looking through the narrow wooden door slit out to the rain-swept courtyard well.
scenes.axis: Sightline from the dark ironwood worship hall through the narrow wooden door crack directly toward the chained laterite well in the rain.
scenes.props: Antique wooden pendulum clock stopped at 02:59, DSLR camera, brass storm lantern, three iron chains vibrating on the laterite well, shifted stone slab, pale mud-stained fingers gripping the well rim.
scenes.setting: First night, steady rain: the dark ironwood worship hall with carved pillars, an altar with two candles, an antique pendulum clock, and a wooden front door with a narrow slit facing the courtyard well.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm đầu tiên mưa ngâu rả rích, cả ngôi nhà gỗ lim rộng lớn nồng nặc mùi gỗ mục và bùn lạnh.
beats: Wide interior view of @Lam holding his DSLR camera and storm lantern among the dark ironwood pillars.
Midnight rain pounds the yin-yang roof tiles as @Lam walks slowly through the silent ironwood hall raising his DSLR camera to photograph the dragon-carved timber pillars.
@Lam lowers his DSLR camera slightly, glancing toward the corner where the antique pendulum clock stands.
clips.sfx: night rain drumming on the old roof tiles, a soft camera-shutter click in the empty hall

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đúng hai giờ năm mươi chín phút đêm, đồng hồ quả lắc bỗng đứng khựng, hai ngọn nến bàn thờ phụt tắt.
beats: Close framing on the antique pendulum clock, its hands at one minute to three, with @Lam standing in the dim background.
The brass pendulum suddenly stops dead and both altar candles blow out, leaving @Lam in flickering lantern light.
The brass pendulum hangs frozen in the dark hall as @Lam stiffens with his lantern.
clips.sfx: the clock's tick stopping with a dry click, a gust snuffing the candles, then eerie silence

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngay lập tức từ dưới đáy giếng đá ong sâu thẳm, ba tiếng gõ trầm đục dội ngược lên nắp đá trấn yểm!
beats: @Lam stands frozen beside the darkened altar table holding his camera and lantern.
In the dead silence, three deep hollow knocks echo up from beneath the stone-sealed well outside in the rain; @Lam flinches hard, clutching his DSLR camera against his chest.
@Lam turns sharply toward the wooden front door, his eyes wide behind his glasses.
clips.sfx: three deep hollow knocks from under the ground, quick frightened breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Qua khe cửa gỗ hẹp, Lâm chết lặng khi thấy ba vòng xích sắt trên miệng giếng tự động giật căng từng hồi.
beats: @Lam presses his eye against the narrow wooden door crack looking out into the rainy courtyard.

@Lam creeps to the wooden door and peers through the narrow slit into the rain-swept courtyard; under a cyan lightning flash, the three thick iron chains on the well jerk and rattle wildly by themselves.
Through the door slit, the three rusted chains rattle taut across the vibrating well slab.
clips.sfx: rusted chains clanging hard against laterite under rolling thunder

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tấm bia đá nặng hàng tạ nhích dần sang bên, năm ngón tay trắng bệch rớm máu thò lên bấu chặt thành giếng!
beats: Close framing on the vibrating stone slab atop the wet laterite well in the rain.

Close view on the rain-lashed laterite well: the heavy stone seal grinds sideways a hand's width, and five pale, mud-soaked, nail-torn fingers slowly thrust out of the black gap to claw the mossy rim.
Five pale mud-stained fingers grip the mossy edge of the shifted well slab in the dark rain.
clips.sfx: heavy stone grinding on the well rim, fingernails scraping laterite

clips.speaker: @CoUt
clips.line: Lâm ơi cứu em ra khỏi đáy giếng lạnh lẽo này với, ở dưới này tối tăm và ngột ngạt lắm Lâm ơi!
beats: @Lam stares through the wooden door crack as @CoUt's pale wet face appears in the gap outside.

Right outside the narrow door slit, @CoUt's pale wet face fills the gap and she speaks in a freezing, sorrowful whisper, her lips visible through the slit; @Lam claps a hand over his own mouth and stumbles backward.
@Lam stumbles backward into the worship hall, a hand over his mouth in terror.
clips.sfx: rain on the courtyard, stumbling backward footsteps

scenes.title: Tấm Khăn Lụa Đen Rơi Xuống & Bóng Người Trong Gương Đồng
scenes.location: Ancestral worship hall interior dominated by an ancient tarnished bronze mirror on a carved wooden stand beside dark ironwood pillars.
scenes.axis: Axis between @Lam standing in the center of the ironwood hall and the tall antique bronze mirror facing the empty shadowed floor behind him.
scenes.props: Tall antique tarnished bronze mirror, black silk veil cloth on the wooden floorboards, brass storm lantern, two wet muddy barefoot prints and wet black hair strands on the dry wood floor.
scenes.setting: First night, rain: the ironwood worship hall with a tall antique bronze mirror draped in black silk, lit by a single storm lantern.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hoảng loạn lùi gấp vào gian thờ, một luồng gió âm hàn bỗng thổi tuột tấm khăn lụa đen trên gương đồng.
beats: @Lam retreats backward from the front door toward the center of the ironwood hall.
@Lam backs away from the front door into the center of the worship hall; an icy gust blows through the door gap and slips the black silk veil off the tall antique bronze mirror onto the floor.
The black silk veil puddles on the floorboards beside @Lam's feet, exposing the tarnished bronze mirror.
clips.sfx: icy wind whistling through the door gap, black silk sliding to the floor

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Theo phản xạ tự nhiên, Lâm cúi xuống nhặt tấm khăn lụa rồi vô tình ngước mắt nhìn thẳng vào mặt gương mờ.
beats: @Lam bends down to gather the black silk veil from the wooden floorboards.
@Lam crouches to pick up the fallen black silk cloth, then freezes as his eyes involuntarily lift straight into the cloudy reflective surface of the ancient bronze mirror.
@Lam rises partway, his gaze locked directly into the tarnished surface of the bronze mirror.
clips.sfx: a heartbeat in the silence, shaky breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong mặt gương đồng ố mờ, ngay sát sau gáy anh là bóng cô gái mặc áo dài trắng ướt đẫm bùn đen!
clips.camera: 50mm stabilized close-up slow push-in on mirror
beats: Close reflection of @Lam in the tarnished bronze mirror holding his flickering lantern.

Close view of the tarnished bronze mirror reflection: @Lam stands holding his brass lantern, and right behind his shoulder inside the mirror stands @CoUt in a soaked white áo dài staring down at his neck.
Inside the mirror, @CoUt's wet pale figure looms directly behind @Lam's shoulder.
clips.sfx: water dripping, a cold breath right at the neck

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Ai đó?! Kẻ nào vừa đứng ngay sát sau lưng tôi ở trong gian nhà thờ tối tăm này thế hả?!
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized arc around @Lam as he turns
beats: @Lam whirls around from the bronze mirror, raising his brass storm lantern behind him.
@Lam gasps and spins around 180 degrees holding his brass storm lantern high to illuminate the hall behind him, shouting in panic, yet the space between the ironwood pillars is completely empty.
@Lam stands trembling with lantern raised toward the empty shadowed space between the pillars.
clips.sfx: feet pivoting on the floorboards, echo in the empty hall

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khoảng không phía sau hoàn toàn trống rỗng, nhưng mặt sàn gỗ khô lại in rõ hai dấu chân bùn đen lạnh ngắt.
beats: @Lam tilts his brass lantern beam downward toward the wooden floorboards behind him.
@Lam lowers his lantern beam to the dry wooden floorboards right where he stood: two distinct wet, black-mud barefoot prints and long strands of wet black hair glisten in the amber light.
The amber lantern light isolates two wet muddy footprints and black hair strands on the floor.
clips.sfx: muddy water dripping on ironwood, the storm lantern sputtering

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khi anh quay lại định trùm khăn, bóng ma trong gương bỗng mỉm cười rồi vươn bàn tay rớm máu ra ngoài!
beats: @Lam turns back toward the bronze mirror lifting the black silk veil in his trembling hands.

As @Lam turns back to throw the black cloth over the mirror, @CoUt inside the bronze reflection smiles eerily and presses her bleeding, mud-stained hand outward against the metal surface, making black water ooze out.
@CoUt's pale hand presses outward from inside the weeping bronze mirror as @Lam recoils.
clips.sfx: bronze ringing coldly, black water trickling down the wooden frame

scenes.title: Bóng Ma Tiến Gần Trong Từng Tấm Ảnh Chụp Đèn Flash
scenes.location: Dimly lit wooden table inside the ancestral main hall surrounded by carved ironwood pillars and deep midnight shadows.
scenes.axis: Tight interior axis around the wooden table where @Lam inspects his DSLR camera LCD screen facing the dark space across the table.
scenes.props: DSLR camera with glowing LCD display and pop-up flash, draped bronze mirror in background, carved wooden table, brass storm lantern.
scenes.setting: Same night until dawn: the worship hall, a wooden table, a DSLR camera and storm-lantern light, rain outside.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tay run cầm cập, Lâm trùm vội khăn kín mặt gương rồi bật màn hình máy ảnh xem lại những tấm hình.
beats: @Lam tosses the black silk cloth over the bronze mirror and backs toward the wooden table.
With shaking hands, @Lam throws the black silk veil over the bronze mirror, retreats to the wooden table, and switches on his DSLR camera screen to review the photos he took earlier.
@Lam sits at the wooden table staring down at the glowing LCD screen of his DSLR camera.
clips.sfx: silk thrown over the mirror, hurried steps, camera buttons clicking

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ở bức ảnh đầu tiên chụp gian nhà trống, nơi góc cột gỗ lim xa xa đã thấp thoáng bóng áo trắng.
beats: Close framing on the glowing camera preview showing the dark ironwood hall interior.

Close view of the camera's visual display (pure image without text): in the first wide photo of the empty hall, the pale white silhouette of @CoUt stands tilting her head beside a far dark ironwood pillar.
In the corner of the displayed photograph, @CoUt's pale figure stands head-tilted by a pillar.
clips.sfx: the dry click of the camera's next-photo button over the night rain

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bấm sang tấm ảnh thứ hai rồi thứ ba, sau mỗi lần chớp đèn thì cái bóng ấy lại tiến gần thêm.
beats: Over @Lam's shoulder looking down at the DSLR camera held in his trembling hands.
@Lam clicks through the second and third photographs with a trembling thumb; in each successive frame, @CoUt's soaking-wet white figure steps several paces closer toward the camera lens.
The third photo shows @CoUt standing mid-hall with water dripping from her hanging hands.
clips.sfx: rapid button clicks, broken frightened breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đến tấm ảnh cuối cùng, khuôn mặt trắng bệch đẫm máu lệ của cô gái đã áp sát rạt ngay trước ống kính!
beats: @Lam's thumb presses the next button on the camera body.
@Lam clicks to the final photograph: the entire frame is filled by @CoUt's corpse-pale face and hollow, dark-teared eyes pressed right against the camera lens.
The screen fills with @CoUt's pale face staring straight out as @Lam freezes in terror.
clips.sfx: a breath caught in the throat, cold wind through the shutters

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đột nhiên đèn flash máy ảnh tự chớp sáng trắng xóa, cô gái áo trắng đang đứng ngay bên kia chiếc bàn gỗ!
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized medium wide shot slow dolly-out
beats: @Lam holds the DSLR camera above the wooden table in the dim lantern light.

The pop-up flash on @Lam's DSLR camera suddenly fires by itself with a blinding white burst; for one split-second flash, @CoUt stands in the flesh right across the wooden table before darkness swallows her.
As the flash afterglow fades, the space across the table is empty and @Lam jerks back.
clips.sfx: a flash capacitor whining, then a sharp flash pop in the dark room

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm kinh hãi đánh rơi máy ảnh, co ro nơi góc tường chờ đến khi tiếng gà gáy canh năm vang lên.
beats: @Lam drops his DSLR camera onto the table and backs into the timber wall corner.
@Lam drops the camera onto the wooden table and retreats into the corner clutching his head, shivering until the first faint rooster crow echoes from the misty hillside at dawn.
@Lam sits huddled against the corner wall as pale grey dawn light begins filtering through the shutters.
clips.sfx: the camera thudding on the wooden table, ragged breathing, a distant rooster at dawn

scenes.title: Buổi Sáng Kỳ Lạ & Cánh Cổng Bị Khóa Trái Bằng Xích Đồng
scenes.time_label: 06:30 Sáng sớm & Chiều muộn Ngày thứ hai (04:00–05:00)
scenes.location: Dense morning fog over the Bát Tràng brick courtyard, the laterite well, and the padlocked outer iron gate bordering the forested hill.
scenes.axis: Courtyard-to-gate axis from the porch steps past the central laterite well to the locked iron gate and misty hillside fence.
scenes.props: Sealed laterite well with a puddle of black water, white jade hairpin (trâm ngọc bội trắng) on the stone slab, green-rusted antique bronze padlock and chain on the iron gate, smartphone with no signal.
scenes.setting: Foggy morning: the courtyard, the chained laterite well and the padlocked stone archway gate.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau sương mù vẫn đặc quánh, Lâm vội vã thu dọn hành lý định bỏ tiền cọc rời đi ngay.
beats: @Lam steps out of the ironwood house onto the foggy morning veranda wearing his leather satchel.
Thick morning fog blankets the courtyard like incense smoke; exhausted and pale, @Lam straps on his leather camera bag and steps off the porch determined to abandon the job immediately.
@Lam walks briskly down the wet porch steps toward the central courtyard well.
clips.sfx: hurried footsteps on dew-wet steps, crows cawing hoarsely in the trees

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đi ngang qua sân, nắp giếng đá ong lại nằm im như cũ nhưng trên mặt đá có chiếc trâm ngọc trắng.
beats: @Lam pauses beside the chained laterite well in the misty morning courtyard.
Passing the laterite well in the foggy courtyard, @Lam stops: the heavy stone slab sits neatly in place as if never moved, but a puddle of black water and a white jade hairpin rest on top.
@Lam picks up the white jade hairpin from the wet stone slab and looks toward the front gate.
clips.sfx: dew dripping into a black puddle on the stone, early wind

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chạy ra tới cổng chính, Lâm bàng hoàng thấy cánh cổng sắt đã bị khóa trái bên ngoài bằng ổ khóa đồng.
beats: @Lam approaches the outer iron gate under the mossy stone archway.

@Lam hurries to the stone archway gate and clutches the iron bars: the gate is padlocked from the outside with a green-rusted bronze lock identical to the caretaker's keys, and his phone has zero signal.
@Lam grips the padlocked iron bars and glances down at his dead smartphone screen.
clips.sfx: a heavy bronze padlock knocking against the iron bars, the silent foggy hillside

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Bà Cầm ơi! Có ai ở ngoài đó không?! Mau mở khóa cổng sắt cho tôi ra khỏi ngôi nhà này với!
beats: @Lam grips the locked iron gate bars with both hands facing the thick white fog.
@Lam rattles the padlocked iron gate bars with both hands, shouting desperately out into the dense white hillside fog, but only his own hollow echo answers back.
@Lam presses his forehead against the cold iron bars, breathing heavily as the echo dies.
clips.sfx: iron bars rattling, an echo off the foggy hills

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giữa màn sương trắng đồi đối diện, cụ Từ giữ đền làng đứng lặng nhìn sang ngôi nhà cổ đầy kinh hãi.
beats: Telephoto view through the swirling morning fog toward the stone path on the opposite slope.
Across the mossy stone fence in the swirling hillside mist stands @CuTu in his traditional dark robe holding a bamboo staff, staring toward the cursed ancestral house with grave dread.
@CuTu stands motionless in the mist gripping his bamboo staff, his stern eyes fixed on the house.
clips.sfx: mountain wind flapping a dark robe, a small bronze bell tinkling
clips.setting: Morning fog on the opposite hillside: a stone path and a mossy stone fence facing the ancestral house.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cơn mưa giông chiều bất ngờ ập xuống tối sầm trời đất, đẩy Lâm phải quay lại ngôi nhà đêm thứ hai.
beats: @Lam at the iron gate shields his eyes as dark storm rain suddenly pours down.
Before @Lam can call out again, a sudden dark afternoon storm cloud bursts into torrential rain, forcing @Lam to retreat backward across the courtyard into the wooden house as Night Two falls.
@Lam retreats onto the dark ironwood veranda as dusk darkness swallows the courtyard.
clips.sfx: thunder rolling, a sudden downpour on the old roof tiles
clips.setting: Afternoon: a sudden dark storm breaks over the stone archway gate and the courtyard.

scenes.title: Đêm Thứ Hai — Xuất Hiện Cánh Cửa Gỗ Thứ Tư Cuối Hành Lang
scenes.location: Narrow, suffocatingly dark ironwood side corridor with three locked wooden bedroom doors leading to a dead-end wooden wall.
scenes.axis: Linear corridor axis from Door 1, Door 2, and Door 3 straight down to the dead-end wall where the mysterious blood-red 4th door manifests.
scenes.props: Brass storm lantern, three locked dark wooden doors, the newly manifested faded blood-red fourth wooden door at the corridor end, torn yellow talisman paper on the door seam, iron latch.
scenes.setting: Second night, rain: a narrow ironwood corridor with three bolted bedroom doors and a dead-end timber wall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm thứ hai không dám chợp mắt, Lâm cầm đèn bão đi dọc hành lang gỗ lim kiểm tra từng chốt cửa.
clips.camera: 28mm stabilized gimbal slow tracking follow shot
beats: @Lam enters the narrow dark ironwood corridor holding his flickering brass storm lantern.
On the second night, @Lam walks cautiously down the narrow, suffocatingly dark ironwood corridor holding his brass storm lantern up to check the door latches as floorboards creak underfoot.
@Lam advances slowly along the timber wall toward the row of bedroom doors.
clips.sfx: ironwood floorboards creaking slowly under each step in the narrow corridor

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đi qua cánh cửa thứ nhất, cánh cửa thứ hai rồi cánh cửa thứ ba đều cài then kín như lời bà dặn.
beats: @Lam shines his lantern beam onto the first wooden door latch along the corridor.
@Lam swings his amber lantern beam across the corridor wall, counting each dark wooden bedroom door in sequence: the first door, the second door, and the third door are all bolted shut.
@Lam moves past the third bolted wooden door toward the dark end of the corridor.
clips.sfx: hands testing wooden latches, night rain on the eaves

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng nơi bức vách gỗ trống ban ngày, nay bỗng lù lù hiện ra cánh cửa buồng thứ tư đỏ sẫm như máu!
beats: @Lam raises his brass lantern toward the dark dead-end wall of the corridor.
As @Lam's lantern light reaches the dead-end wall — which was blank timber by day — a faded deep crimson fourth wooden door now looms before him, sealed with a yellow talisman torn in half.
The amber beam reveals the deep crimson fourth wooden door with its torn yellow talisman.
clips.sfx: a choked breath, a torn yellow talisman fluttering in the cold draft

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Từ sau cánh cửa cấm kỵ ấy, tiếng khung cửi dệt vải lách cách vang lên đều đặn hòa tiếng con gái khóc.
beats: @Lam stands frozen two steps from the deep crimson fourth door listening intently.
@Lam freezes before the deep crimson fourth door as the rhythmic clatter of an ancient wooden weaving loom and the muffled, heartbroken weeping of a young woman echo from behind the wood.
@Lam's eyes widen behind his glasses as the weeping inside the fourth room grows clearer.
clips.sfx: the rhythmic clack of a wooden weaving loom and a young woman's muffled weeping behind the door

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm nhắm chặt mắt bước lùi, nhưng mới lùi được ba bước thì cánh cửa thứ tư bỗng tự bật chốt mở toang!
beats: @Lam closes his eyes tightly and steps backward down the narrow wooden corridor.
Remembering the third taboo, @Lam squeezes his eyes shut and takes three slow steps backward, but the iron latch on the fourth door suddenly snaps open and both red wooden panels creak wide.
@Lam opens his eyes in shock as the deep crimson fourth door swings wide open before him.
clips.sfx: an iron latch snapping open with a sharp clack, rotten hinges creaking long

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Một luồng lực lạnh buốt vô hình níu chặt dây máy ảnh, kéo anh bước qua ngưỡng cửa vào buồng niêm phong.
beats: @Lam stands before the open threshold of the fourth door as his camera strap pulls taut.
An icy draft tugs the camera strap across @Lam's chest; as if in a trance, @Lam steps across the threshold of the fourth door into the pitch-black sealed room.
@Lam stands just inside the dark sealed room, holding his lantern.
clips.sfx: a hollow draft drawing into the dark room, footsteps crossing the threshold

scenes.title: Căn Buồng Bị Niêm Phong 50 Năm & Đường Hầm Thông Xuống Đáy Giếng
scenes.location: Dusty cobweb-draped maiden bedroom sealed for 50 years behind the fourth door, containing a rotting wooden loom, vanity table, and hidden stone trapdoor.
scenes.axis: Interior axis from the fourth door threshold past the cobwebbed loom and vanity table down to the floor trapdoor opening into the flooded underground well shaft.
scenes.props: Cobwebbed wooden loom, dusty vanity with a scratched-out ancestral portrait of @CoUt, torn straw mat, laterite stone trapdoor scarred with claw marks, flooded subterranean shaft, family portrait on wall, bronze exorcism bell.
scenes.setting: Second night: the sealed fourth room — a half-century-old maiden's chamber full of white cobwebs, a rotting wooden loom, a dusty vanity table and a laterite trapdoor in the floor.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bên trong cánh cửa thứ tư là khuê phòng cổ phủ đầy mạng nhện trắng xóa, chiếc khung cửi mục nằm im lìm.
beats: @Lam steps inside the cobweb-covered maiden's bedroom holding his lantern high.
@Lam raises his brass lantern inside the fourth room, revealing a 50-year-old maiden's chamber draped in white cobwebs like funeral shrouds, with a rotting wooden loom now completely still.
@Lam shines his lantern past the silent wooden loom toward a dusty vanity table.
clips.sfx: footsteps in thick dust, cobweb strands snapping softly in the stale air

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trên chiếc bàn trang điểm bụi bặm là di ảnh cô gái áo trắng, nhưng đôi mắt đã bị ai cào nát.
beats: Close view of the dusty vanity table as lantern light sweeps onto a carved wooden portrait frame.
In the frame is a sepia portrait of @CoUt in a white áo dài, but both eyes on the photograph have been scratched out.
Tight framing on the defaced portrait of @CoUt, both eyes scratched out of the paper.
clips.sfx: wind whistling through rotten wall gaps, a low mournful hum around the portrait

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chiếu đèn xuống dưới lớp chiếu cói mục, một nắp hầm đá ong lộ ra chi chít vết móng tay cào đẫm máu.
beats: @Lam aims his lantern beam downward at the floor beside the vanity table.

@Lam shines his lantern down beneath the vanity table where a rotted straw mat is peeled back, exposing a laterite stone floor trapdoor scarred underneath with hundreds of dark dried fingernail grooves.
@Lam kneels beside the exposed laterite stone trapdoor covered in deep scratch marks.
clips.sfx: a rotten straw mat rustling, horrified breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nắp hầm ấy thông thẳng xuống đáy giếng ngoài sân, nơi đây thực chất là một ngục ngầm dùng chôn sống người!
beats: @Lam grips the iron ring of the laterite floor trapdoor and lifts it open.
@Lam pries open the heavy laterite trapdoor a few inches: beneath lies a vertical flooded stone shaft connecting straight to the courtyard well, exhaling freezing mist and a stench of stagnant mud.
@Lam peers down into the dark water-filled shaft as cold white mist billows up.
clips.sfx: a heavy laterite slab shifting, underground water slapping far below

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Từ dưới hầm nước đen ngòm, bóng cô gái bất ngờ trồi lên rồi chỉ thẳng tay vào bức ảnh gia tộc trên vách!
beats: Low angle from the open floor shaft as @CoUt's wet pale figure rises into lantern light.
Suddenly from the black water of the open shaft, @CoUt rises to the rim with dark tear-streaked eyes; instead of harming @Lam, she raises a pale wet hand and points at the clan portrait on the wall.
@CoUt points her trembling pale finger toward the wall portrait while @Lam falls back on the floor.
clips.sfx: water surging up from the shaft, a mournful echoing wind

clips.speaker: @CuTu
clips.line: Cậu đừng sợ! Oán hồn cô ấy đang chỉ mặt kẻ thủ ác đã chôn sống mình năm mươi năm trước đấy!
beats: @Lam scrambles back on the floor as @CuTu steps through the doorway ringing his bronze bell.
As @Lam falls backward onto the floor, @CuTu bursts through the room door holding his bamboo staff and rings his bronze exorcism bell sharply, speaking in a solemn, commanding Northern voice.
@CuTu stands protectively beside @Lam, holding his bronze bell toward the subsiding shaft.
clips.sfx: a bronze bell ringing sharply, cutting through the cold air

scenes.title: Cụ Từ Tiết Lộ Thảm Án 50 Năm Trước & Sự Thật Về Bà Cầm
scenes.location: Main ancestral ironwood hall lit by a flickering oil lamp and external lightning flashes, with the old Vũ clan family portrait hanging on the timber wall.
scenes.axis: Main hall table and portrait wall axis where @CuTu and @Lam confront the 50-year-old crime, intercut with a spectral vision of the courtyard well.
scenes.props: Bronze exorcism bell and bamboo staff on the wooden table, faded Vũ clan portrait on the wall, brass storm lantern, rain-lashed window shutters illuminated by lightning.
scenes.setting: Second night, rain and lightning: the main worship hall with its wooden table, a brass oil lamp and an old family portrait on the timber wall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tiếng chuông đồng thanh mảnh của cụ Từ Hạc giúp Lâm trấn tĩnh, rồi cụ thở dài kể lại thảm án năm xưa.
beats: @CuTu helps @Lam up and guides him out of the fourth room into the main hall.
@CuTu leads @Lam back into the main ancestral hall and sets the bronze bell on the wooden table as the darkness of the fourth room recedes behind them.
@CuTu places his bronze bell on the main hall table opposite @Lam.
clips.sfx: the bronze bell's warm lingering ring on the table, rain easing on the eaves

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Năm mươi năm trước, vì tham gia sản nhà họ Vũ, mụ quản gia tên Cầm đã độc ác vu oan cho cô Út.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow push-in on wall portrait
beats: @CuTu lifts the brass oil lamp toward a faded family photograph on the timber wall.
The lamplight reveals an old black-and-white portrait: young @CoUt standing beside a much younger @BaCam, the caretaker, fifty years ago.
The lamplight isolates young @CoUt and the young caretaker @BaCam in the old photo.
clips.sfx: the oil lamp crackling, the old man's heavy sigh

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong đêm mưa tháng Bảy ấy, mụ trói cô thả xuống giếng rồi dùng bia đá Chu Sa và xích sắt khóa chặt.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow push-in toward the well
beats: Dim, desaturated flashback: rain pours over the courtyard well; a white jade hairpin lies on the wet rim.
The heavy red-inscribed stone slab slides shut over the dark well mouth and three iron chains drop across it, locked with a bronze padlock; a torn strip of white silk is caught under the slab.
The sealed, chained well sits alone in the pouring rain.
clips.sfx: rain on the courtyard, iron chains clanking shut on stone, then deep silence
clips.setting: Flashback, a rainy night fifty years ago: the courtyard well, dim and desaturated.

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Khoan đã cụ ơi, vậy bà lão mặc áo đen đưa chìa khóa bắt cháu lăn tay chiều hôm qua là ai?!
beats: Medium close-up of @Lam in the main hall staring wide-eyed at @CuTu across the wooden table.
Back in the main hall, @Lam's face goes deathly pale as he remembers the old woman in black who handed him the keys yesterday evening; he grips the table edge and asks @CuTu in a trembling voice.
@Lam leans forward gripping the wooden table edge, awaiting @CuTu's answer in dread.
clips.sfx: night rain on the eaves

clips.speaker: @CuTu
clips.line: Cậu nói cái gì cơ?! Bà Cầm quản gia đã ngã gãy cổ chết cứng dưới đáy giếng từ ba năm trước rồi!
beats: @CuTu reaches across the wooden table and takes @Lam's wrist, his face stricken.
@CuTu's weathered face turns ashen in the amber lamplight; holding @Lam's wrist, he speaks the terrible truth in a low, gravelly voice, his face toward the camera.
@Lam stares at @CuTu, stunned, as lightning begins to flicker outside.
clips.sfx: thunder rumbling from the foot of the hill

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tiếng sét nổ đoàng xé toạc màn đêm, kẻ ký hợp đồng với Lâm chiều hôm qua chính là cái xác đội mồ!
beats: Harsh blue-white lightning flashes through the window onto @Lam's frozen face.
A bright bolt of lightning flashes outside the wooden lattice window, illuminating @Lam's frozen face, lips parted, breath held as he realizes the woman who hired him was an apparition from the past.
@Lam stands trembling beside the table as the thunderclap rumbles across the dark house.
clips.sfx: a deafening thunderclap right over the old roof, howling storm wind

scenes.title: Tờ Hợp Đồng Hóa Vàng Mã & Khế Ước Bắt Người Thế Mạng
scenes.location: Wooden table in the ancestral main hall looking toward the rain-swept front veranda doors.
scenes.axis: Tabletop close-up axis between @Lam and @CuTu examining the contract, aligned with the front wooden lattice doors leading to the dark porch.
scenes.props: Leather satchel, envelope spilling rotting yellow underworld joss paper money (tiền vàng mã âm phủ ẩm mục), ancient blood-stamped Soul-Substitution Pact (Khế Ước Thế Mạng), brass oil lamp.
scenes.setting: Second night, storm: the main worship hall, a wooden table under a brass oil lamp, wooden lattice front doors facing the rainy veranda.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Rụng rời cả tay chân, Lâm lao vội tới bàn gỗ mở chiếc phong bì tiền cọc mà bà Cầm đưa chiều qua.
beats: @Lam hurries across the main hall to his leather satchel on the wooden table.
Shaking from head to toe, @Lam tears open the brown envelope of advance cash the old caretaker gave him the previous evening.
@Lam tips the torn envelope upside down over the tabletop under the lamplight.
clips.sfx: a leather satchel clasp popping open, an envelope torn open in a hurry

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đổ ra mặt bàn gỗ chẳng có tờ tiền thật nào, chỉ toàn tiền vàng mã âm phủ ố mục tanh mùi bùn!
beats: Close view of the envelope tipping over the wooden tabletop in amber lantern light.
Macro tabletop view: spilling out of the envelope onto the dark wood is not real currency, but a stack of rotting, mud-stained yellow underworld joss paper money oozing black well silt.
Rotting mud-stained underworld joss paper notes lie scattered across the table before @Lam.
clips.sfx: damp joss paper slapping onto the wooden table, a sharp frightened inhale

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cụ Từ mở tờ giấy điểm chỉ mực đỏ ra xem dưới đèn dầu, đó chính là tờ Khế Ước Thế Mạng tà thuật!
beats: @CuTu picks up the red-stamped contract paper beside the pile of joss money.
@CuTu unfolds the coarse yellowed paper bearing @Lam's red-ink thumbprint under the brass oil lamp, revealing ancient black talismanic characters of a forbidden Soul-Substitution Pact.
@CuTu and @Lam stare down at the red-ink thumbprint glowing ominously on the ancient pact.
clips.sfx: old paper rustling under the oil lamp, icy wind on the veranda

clips.speaker: @CuTu
clips.line: Bà Cầm lừa cậu lăn tay giữ nắp giếng ba đêm, để đúng giờ Dần lấy mạng cậu thế chỗ dưới đáy giếng!
beats: Medium close-up of @CuTu pointing at the red thumbprint on the pact paper.
@CuTu taps the red thumbprint on the cursed paper and explains the plot, his face toward the camera, as the shadowy reflection of @BaCam flickers for an instant on the rainy window lattice.
@CuTu lifts his gaze toward the front veranda doors as a cold draft sweeps the room.
clips.sfx: a finger tapping the table, rapid thunder and lightning outside

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hóa ra ba điều cấm chính là để ngăn Lâm mở nắp giếng cứu cô Út trước giờ đòi mạng vào đêm mai.
beats: @Lam grips the edge of the pact paper with trembling fingers.
@Lam clutches the cursed contract as the truth sinks in: the three taboos were meant to stop him from opening the well before the final night.
@Lam slowly turns his head toward the front lattice doors as a metallic jingle echoes outside.
clips.sfx: the pact paper crumpling in a fist, a pounding heartbeat

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đúng lúc sự thật kinh hoàng hé lộ, ngoài hiên tối bỗng vang lên tiếng chùm chìa khóa đồng khua trong mưa.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow dolly push-in toward door
beats: @Lam freezes beside the table, eyes locked on the front wooden lattice doors.
From the dark, rain-lashed veranda beyond the lattice doors comes the slow jingle of a bronze key ring, approaching step by step.
A tall, stooped shadow under an umbrella falls across the rain-streaked lattice doors.
clips.sfx: bronze keys jingling slowly with wet, muddy footsteps on the veranda

scenes.title: Ác Linh Bà Cầm Hiện Nguyên Hình Ngoài Hiên Nhà Cổ
scenes.location: Threshold between the ancestral main hall and the rain-drenched front veranda through wooden lattice doors.
scenes.axis: Direct sightline through the wooden lattice doors out to the porch steps where the crooked-necked revenant @BaCam stands under her black umbrella.
scenes.props: Wooden lattice doors, black oiled-paper umbrella dripping black mud, rusted bronze key ring scraping the wood bars, red cinnabar talisman (bùa Chu Sa) and bronze bell.
scenes.setting: Second night, storm: the rainy veranda seen through the wooden lattice front doors, and the lamplit main hall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngoài hiên nhà mưa gió, bóng bà Cầm đứng lù lù dưới chiếc ô rách, nước bùn đen kịt chảy tràn bậc thềm.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow push-in through lattice door
beats: View through the wooden lattice bars toward @BaCam's silhouette on the dark rainy porch.
Seen through the wooden lattice door bars out on the rain-swept veranda, @BaCam stands motionless under her torn black oiled-paper umbrella as thick black well mud drips from her tunic hem.
@BaCam stands right outside the wooden lattice threshold dripping black well mud onto the stone step.
clips.sfx: black mud dripping onto the stone step, rain on the oiled-paper umbrella

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới ánh chớp xanh lè, bà lão từ từ ngẩng lên với cái cổ gãy vẹo hẳn sang vai và đôi mắt trắng dã!
beats: Close framing through the lattice bars as @BaCam slowly raises her bowed head under lightning.
Under an eerie green-blue lightning flash, @BaCam lifts her head: it hangs crookedly to one side at an unnatural angle, both milky-white eyes glaring at @Lam.
@BaCam's crooked face glares through the wooden bars while @Lam recoils inside.
clips.sfx: a dry creak, rasping breath like wind over a graveyard

clips.speaker: @BaCam
clips.line: Mày đã điểm chỉ máu vào khế ước rồi con ạ, đêm mai đúng ba giờ sáng hồn mày phải thế chỗ tao!
beats: Tight close-up of @BaCam pressing her long-nailed hand and bronze keys against the wooden lattice.
@BaCam drags her long-nailed hand and bronze key ring slowly down the lattice bars and speaks in a raspy, graveside voice, her face toward the camera through the bars.
@BaCam's twisted face stares through the bars as the bronze keys scrape down the wood.
clips.sfx: long nails and bronze keys scraping down the ironwood bars

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cụ Từ Hạc lập tức lao lên dán lá bùa Chu Sa vào cửa gỗ, đánh bật luồng âm khí đen kịt ra sân.
beats: @CuTu strides toward the lattice door holding a red cinnabar talisman and his bronze bell.
@CuTu rings the bell and presses the red talisman onto the centre of the ironwood door; the talisman flares crimson and @BaCam's figure outside recoils, drifting backward off the porch into the rain.
@BaCam's dark figure drifts backward off the porch steps into the rain, repelled by the talisman glow.
clips.sfx: a bronze bell ringing, the talisman flaring with a crimson whoomp, a hoarse ghostly scream

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cái bóng đen lưng còng lùi dần vào màn sương đặc quánh, để lại tiếng cười khàn đục hẹn giờ đòi mạng đêm cuối.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow push-in into courtyard mist
beats: @BaCam drifts backward across the wet brick courtyard toward the dark tree line.
Stooped and crooked-necked, @BaCam retreats into the swirling fog behind the ancient courtyard trees, leaving an echoing hoarse laugh.
@BaCam dissolves into the thick courtyard fog under her torn black umbrella.
clips.sfx: hoarse laughter fading into the rain, iron chains ringing faintly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cụ Từ nắm chặt vai Lâm dặn muốn sống thì trước ba giờ sáng mai phải đập vỡ bia đá cứu cô Út!
beats: @CuTu turns from the talisman-sealed door and grips @Lam's shoulders firmly.
Inside the hall, @CuTu holds @Lam's shoulders with fierce urgency, explaining that the chains and stone seal on the well must be broken before three tomorrow night.
@Lam nods with fierce determination as @CuTu points to a heavy iron sledgehammer by the wall.
clips.sfx: two men's quick breathing in the hall, distant night thunder

scenes.title: Đêm Thứ Ba (02:45 Sáng) — Nước Giếng Đen Tràn Ngập & Bóng Ma Bước Ra Từ Gương
scenes.location: Ancestral main hall flooding ankle-deep with black well water around the rippling antique bronze mirror.
scenes.axis: Main hall axis from @Lam and @CuTu holding the iron sledgehammer toward the burning black veil and rippling bronze mirror.
scenes.props: Heavy iron sledgehammer, white jade hairpin, antique pendulum clock at 02:45, ankle-deep black well water seeping through floorboards, bronze mirror rippling like water.
scenes.setting: Third night, fierce storm: the worship hall with the pendulum clock and the bronze mirror; black well water seeping up through the floorboards.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm thứ ba lúc hai giờ bốn mươi lăm phút sáng, mưa bão gào thét dữ dội làm rung chuyển cả ngôi nhà cổ.
beats: @Lam stands in the main hall gripping a heavy iron sledgehammer beside @CuTu.
Deep in the third night a fierce storm shakes the ancestral house as @Lam and @CuTu watch the antique pendulum clock in the worship hall.
@Lam's gaze drops from the clock to the floorboards as dark water begins seeping up.
clips.sfx: storm winds pounding the roof, the pendulum clock ticking fast

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Từ dưới các khe ván sàn gỗ lim, nước giếng đen ngòm tanh nồng mùi bùn bắt đầu sủi bọt dâng ngập mắt cá.
beats: High angle tilting down from @Lam's knees to the ironwood floorboards.
Through the seams of the dark ironwood floorboards and from beneath the bronze mirror stand, freezing black well water bubbles up rapidly, flooding ankle-deep around @Lam's boots.
Black, foul-smelling well water swirls ankle-deep across the main hall floor around @Lam's boots.
clips.sfx: black water bubbling up from under the floor, icy water lapping around boots

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tấm khăn đen tự bốc lửa xanh cháy rụi, mặt gương đồng gợn sóng rồi bóng cô Út bước thẳng ra gian nhà!
beats: The black silk cloth on the bronze mirror ignites in cold blue flame and falls away.

The black silk veil on the antique bronze mirror bursts into eerie blue-green flames and turns to ash; the bronze mirror surface ripples like deep well water as @CoUt steps straight out into the room.
@CoUt steps barefoot out of the rippling bronze mirror onto the flooded wooden floor.
clips.sfx: ghost-fire flaring with a soft whoomp, water parting as a figure steps out of the mirror

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cô gái áo trắng đứng lặng giữa sàn nhà ngập nước, đôi mắt đẫm lệ nhìn chiếc trâm ngọc trên tay Lâm.
beats: @CoUt stands in the flooded hall facing @Lam across a few paces of black water.
@CoUt stands motionless in the ankle-deep black water with soaking hair hanging to her waist, her tear-filled dark eyes fixed on the iron sledgehammer and the white jade hairpin in @Lam's hand.
@CoUt's sorrowful eyes focus on the white jade hairpin and iron sledgehammer held by @Lam.
clips.sfx: water dripping from a white áo dài into the flooded floor, a cold draft

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Cô Út ơi! Tôi đã thấu rõ nỗi oan của cô rồi, đêm nay tôi quyết đập nát bia đá giải thoát cho cô!
beats: @Lam takes a firm step forward through the ankle-deep water toward @CoUt.
Shivering in the freezing water, @Lam does not retreat; he steps forward through the black water, holding up the white jade hairpin and the heavy iron sledgehammer as he vows to free her.
@Lam holds the white jade hairpin and iron sledgehammer high before @CoUt's pale face.
clips.sfx: firm steps through the flood water

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nghe lời ấy luồng oán khí dịu xuống, cô gái rơi một giọt lệ trong vắt rồi chỉ tay ra chiếc giếng ngoài sân.
beats: Close framing on @CoUt's pale face as the floating hair around her shoulders settles down.
Hearing @Lam's vow, the floating black hair around @CoUt settles gently; a single clear tear rolls down her pale cheek before she raises her chained wrist to point out toward the courtyard well.
@CoUt raises her chained wrist pointing straight through the hall doorway toward the courtyard well.
clips.sfx: a tear dropping into still water, the wooden door blowing open to the storm

scenes.title: Cuộc Vây Hãm Của Ác Linh Bà Cầm Ngoài Sân Mưa Bão
scenes.location: Storm-lashed Bát Tràng brick courtyard in torrential rain between the porch steps and the chained laterite well.
scenes.axis: Courtyard combat axis from the wooden porch doors across the flooded brick tiles to the central chained laterite well.
scenes.props: Heavy iron sledgehammer, extinguished brass storm lantern, spinning black oiled-paper umbrella, three animated rusted iron chains coiling around @Lam's ankle, peach-wood sword (kiếm gỗ đào) and ebony prayer beads.
scenes.setting: Third night, storm: the flooded brick courtyard and the chained laterite well under lightning.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chỉ còn vài phút nữa là điểm ba giờ sáng, Lâm và cụ Từ tung cửa lao ra sân mưa hướng về miệng giếng.
beats: @Lam carrying the iron sledgehammer and @CuTu burst out the front doors onto the flooded porch.
Only minutes before three o'clock, @Lam and @CuTu burst through the wooden porch doors into the storm-flooded brick courtyard, running toward the chained laterite well.
Both men splash down the stone steps into the storm-lashed courtyard toward the well.
clips.sfx: wooden doors banging open against the wall, running feet splashing through the flooded courtyard

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng ác linh bà Cầm đã đứng chắn ngay trước giếng, xoay tít chiếc ô đen thổi tắt phụt ngọn đèn bão!
beats: @Lam and @CuTu run toward the well as @BaCam appears directly in their path.
Right in front of the laterite well, the crooked-necked spirit @BaCam blocks their way; she spins her black oiled-paper umbrella and a gust of dark wind snuffs out @Lam's lantern.
@BaCam's black umbrella whirls as a gust of dark wind sweeps past @Lam and his lantern goes dark.
clips.sfx: the umbrella whirring like a whirlwind, lantern glass cracking as the flame dies

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ba sợi xích sắt trên miệng giếng bỗng trườn ra như rắn độc, hất tung nước làm Lâm trượt ngã xuống sân!
beats: The rusted iron chains on the well begin to uncoil and slither across the flooded courtyard.

The three rusted chains slide off the well mouth like iron serpents, throwing up sheets of water across the wet bricks; @Lam, rushing forward, slips on the flooded bricks and falls into the muddy water.
@Lam lies on his back in the rain beside the writhing chains, the sledgehammer just out of reach.
clips.sfx: iron chains whipping across wet bricks, a slip and a heavy splash

clips.speaker: @CuTu
clips.line: Lâm! Cậu mau dùng búa sắt đập đứt khóa xích trên tấm bia đá đi, để lão già này cầm chân mụ ta!
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized gimbal, medium-wide, slow lateral track
beats: @CuTu steps between the fallen @Lam and the approaching @BaCam, raising his bronze bell and a glowing red talisman.
@CuTu plants his bamboo staff and holds up the bell and talisman, shouting back over his shoulder to @Lam with his face toward the camera, as @BaCam halts a few steps away before the glow.
@CuTu stands his ground before @BaCam, the talisman glowing between them, while @Lam reaches for his hammer.
clips.sfx: a bronze bell ringing over the thunder and pouring rain

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới màn mưa trắng xóa, cụ Từ dồn hết sức niệm chú trấn giữ tà linh mụ quản gia đang điên cuồng gào thét.
beats: @CuTu stands firm on the wet bricks, holding up his bronze bell and ebony prayer beads toward @BaCam.
@CuTu rings the bell and chants; a ring of crimson talisman light holds @BaCam at a distance, and she shrieks and twists in the rain but cannot come closer.
Crimson talisman light flickers in the pouring rain between @CuTu and @BaCam.
clips.sfx: a bell ringing, low chanting, a hoarse ghostly shriek, thunder cracking

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm nghiến chặt răng gượng dậy, ôm búa sắt bò trườn qua làn nước mưa ngập sân tới sát thành giếng.
beats: @Lam pushes himself up from the flooded bricks with the iron sledgehammer in hand.
Clenching his teeth, @Lam crawls through the muddy rainwater, dragging the sledgehammer, until his free hand reaches the mossy laterite well rim.
@Lam's mud-streaked hand grips the well rim as he hauls the sledgehammer up beside him.
clips.sfx: heavy breathing, water splashing, pouring rain

scenes.title: Nhát Búa Lúc 2 Giờ 59 Phút — Đập Vỡ Bia Trấn Yểm Đáy Giếng
scenes.location: Immediate rim of the mossy laterite stone well in the center of the storm-drenched courtyard.
scenes.axis: Tight dramatic focus on the laterite well rim, the three iron chains, and the red-inscribed stone seal slab.
scenes.props: Heavy iron sledgehammer striking sparks off rusted iron chains, cracked stone seal slab, burning Soul-Substitution Pact turning to mud-ash, rising white pomelo-blossom mist from the open well.
scenes.setting: Third night, the storm at its peak: the chained laterite well in the flooded courtyard.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bám chặt vào thành giếng trơn trượt, Lâm vung búa sắt giáng xuống thật mạnh, chặt đứt tung vòng xích sắt thứ nhất!
beats: @Lam pulls himself up against the laterite well rim, raising the heavy iron sledgehammer.
Bracing against the slippery rim, @Lam brings the sledgehammer down onto the bronze padlock and the first iron chain, breaking the links in a shower of sparks.
Sparks fly as the first rusted chain snaps apart across the stone slab.
clips.sfx: a sledgehammer clanging on iron with a shower of sparks in the rain

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ác linh bà Cầm rú lên lao tới định cướp mạng anh, nhưng bóng trắng cô Út đã kịp hiện ra chắn trước mặt!
beats: @BaCam slips past the edge of the talisman light and surges toward @Lam at the well rim.
@BaCam shrieks and rushes at @Lam, but before she reaches him a burst of white mist erupts between them and @CoUt's white figure appears in it, blocking the way; @BaCam halts and recoils.
@CoUt stands in the white mist between @Lam and @BaCam as @BaCam staggers back.
clips.sfx: a ghostly shriek cut off by a rush of clean white wind

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Không chậm trễ một giây, Lâm vung búa chặt đứt hai vòng xích còn lại rồi giáng thẳng đầu búa vào tấm bia đá!
beats: @Lam swings the iron sledgehammer across the second and third rusted chains on the well.

Without losing a second, @Lam swings his iron sledgehammer twice more to sever the remaining two iron chains, then raises the hammer overhead aimed straight at the center of the red-inscribed stone seal.
@Lam raises the sledgehammer high above his head aimed at the center of the red stone slab.
clips.sfx: two ringing clangs as the chains break, a grunt of effort

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Tấm bia trấn yểm này hãy vỡ toạc ra đi!! Trả lại ánh sáng tự do cho người bị chôn dưới đáy giếng sâu!!
beats: Low angle on @Lam raising the iron sledgehammer above the centre of the stone seal, his face toward the camera.
@Lam cries out his vow and brings the sledgehammer down into the centre of the cursed slab; the heavy stone cracks in half.
The red-inscribed slab splits in two and slides off the open mouth of the laterite well.
clips.sfx: laterite stone cracking with a booming crash

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tấm bia đá vừa vỡ toác làm đôi, tờ khế ước tự bốc lửa xanh rồi tà linh bà Cầm tan thành vũng bùn đen!
beats: @BaCam clutches her chest as cold blue flames flicker from the pact paper inside her tunic.
The instant the seal breaks, the pact paper in @BaCam's tunic bursts into cold blue fire; @BaCam shudders and crumbles into a puddle of black mud in the rain.
Only a pool of black mud remains on the wet courtyard bricks.
clips.sfx: blue fire hissing in the rain, a despairing scream dying into the slump of mud

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cơn cuồng phong mưa bão lập tức lặng tờ, từ dưới lòng giếng mở toang một làn sương trắng thanh khiết bay lên.
beats: @Lam kneels breathless beside the open laterite well as the rain abruptly ceases.
The thunderstorm stops instantly; from the newly unsealed mouth of the laterite stone well, a gentle column of pure white mist carrying the scent of ancient pomelo blossoms rises into the night air.
Luminous white mist rises gently from the open well mouth around @Lam in the quiet courtyard.
clips.sfx: the storm stopping dead, pure silence, clear well water chiming

scenes.title: Giọt Nước Mắt Giải Oan & Lời Tạ Từ Bên Miệng Giếng
scenes.time_label: 03:05 Rạng sáng Đêm thứ ba sau cơn bão (13:00–14:00)
scenes.location: Moonlit Bát Tràng brick courtyard around the unsealed, crystal-clear laterite stone well under a clearing 7th-month full moon.
scenes.axis: Serene moonlit courtyard axis around the open laterite well between @Lam, @CuTu, and the purified spirit of @CoUt.
scenes.props: Open laterite stone well filled with crystal-clear water reflecting the full moon, white jade hairpin placed on the mossy well rim, glowing fireflies ascending into the night sky.
scenes.setting: After the storm, the same night: a clear full moon over the wet brick courtyard and the open well.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Mây đen trên đỉnh đồi dần tan biến, trả lại ánh trăng rằm tháng Bảy trong trẻo chiếu sáng khoảng sân gạch cổ.
beats: High angle tilting down from the clearing full moon to the quiet brick courtyard.
Dark storm clouds part overhead to reveal the clear 7th-month full moon, casting silvery-white moonlight down across the wet Bát Tràng brick courtyard and the open laterite well where @Lam stands.
Silver moonlight bathes @Lam standing beside the open laterite stone well.
clips.sfx: gentle night wind through the trees, the last raindrops falling

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khi nhìn xuống lòng giếng đá ong, làn nước đen hôi tanh đã biến mất, chỉ còn mạch nước ngầm trong vắt ánh trăng.
beats: @Lam and @CuTu step side by side to peer down into the unsealed laterite well.
@Lam and @CuTu lean over the mossy laterite well rim looking down: the foul black mud water has vanished completely, replaced by crystal-clear spring water reflecting the full moon.
Inside the well, crystal-clear water mirrors the silver full moon and their calm faces.
clips.sfx: spring water trickling softly at the bottom of the well

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bên thành giếng cổ dưới ánh trăng bạc, bóng cô Út hiện lên dịu dàng trong tà áo dài lụa trắng tinh khôi.
beats: Silver moonlight condenses beside the mossy well rim into @CoUt's luminous figure.
Beside the mossy well under the silver moonlight, @CoUt appears no longer soaked in black mud or bound in chains, but as a serene 19-year-old maiden in a pure, clean white silk áo dài.
@CoUt stands serenely in a spotless white silk áo dài with gentle, grateful eyes gazing just past the camera.
clips.sfx: a wind chime tinkling softly in the calm moonlit night

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm thành kính dùng hai tay đặt chiếc trâm ngọc trắng lên thành giếng, trả lại kỷ vật cho người thiếu nữ bạc mệnh.
beats: @Lam extends both hands holding the white jade hairpin toward the well rim.
With deep reverence, @Lam uses both hands to place the white jade hairpin gently onto the mossy laterite well rim right in front of @CoUt.
The white jade hairpin rests on the moonlit laterite stone before @CoUt.
clips.sfx: a tiny click of jade on mossy laterite

clips.speaker: @CoUt
clips.line: Đa tạ người đã mở giếng giải oan cho em, từ nay ngôi nhà cổ này không còn tiếng khóc đêm ba giờ nữa.
beats: @CoUt stands before @Lam and @CuTu beside the moonlit well, bowing her head gently.
@CoUt bows her head gracefully toward @Lam and @CuTu with a peaceful smile, her pure Northern voice echoing softly like a night breeze across the courtyard.
@CoUt smiles peacefully as warm golden-white light begins shimmering around her shoulders.
clips.sfx: leaves rustling gently

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dứt lời, bóng người thiếu nữ hóa thành muôn vàn đom đóm sáng dịu dàng, bay vút qua mái ngói tan vào ánh trăng.
beats: @CoUt's figure beside the well shimmers and breaks into thousands of glowing fireflies.
@CoUt's luminous white form dissolves into thousands of soft golden fireflies that swirl upward past the yin-yang tiled roof and vanish into the tranquil moonlit sky.
The stream of fireflies ascends above the ancestral house roof into the starry moonlit sky.
clips.sfx: a light, airy shimmering tone as fireflies rise into the night sky

scenes.title: Bình Minh Trên Nhà Cổ & Dấu Tay Hơi Nước Trên Gương Đồng
scenes.location: Sunlit three-bay ironwood ancestral house, green hillside gravesite, bright worship hall with the uncovered bronze mirror, and open courtyard gate.
scenes.axis: Morning resolution progression from the sunlit rooftop and hillside grave back into the bright main hall mirror and out through the open stone gate.
scenes.props: Warm morning sunlight beams, newly tended hillside grave with incense smoke, uncovered polished antique bronze mirror with a fading condensation handprint, leather camera satchel.
scenes.setting: Morning of the fourth day: warm golden sunlight on the ironwood house, the dry veranda and the green hills.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng sớm ngày thứ tư, ánh nắng bình minh ấm áp xuyên qua vòm cây cổ thụ, sưởi ấm từng thớ gỗ ngôi nhà cổ.
beats: Golden morning sunlight illuminates the yin-yang tiled roof and veranda where @Lam stands.
Warm golden dawn sunlight streams through the ancient tree canopy onto the three-bay ironwood ancestral house as @Lam steps out onto the dry veranda, the heavy curse completely lifted.
@Lam breathes in the fresh morning air on the sunlit porch looking out over the hills.
clips.sfx: early birds singing in the old trees, a fresh morning breeze

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Lâm cùng cụ Từ đưa phần hài cốt cô Út lên sườn đồi đầy nắng an táng tử tế, khép lại nỗi oan nửa thế kỷ.
beats: @Lam and @CuTu stand with clasped hands before a clean stone grave on the sunny hillside.
On a sunlit grassy hillside overlooking the valley, @Lam and @CuTu bow respectfully before a newly built, clean stone grave for cô Út as fragrant sandalwood incense smoke curls upward.
Three sticks of incense burn with gentle white smoke atop the grave under morning sun.
clips.sfx: hillside breeze through the grass, incense burning quietly
clips.setting: Sunny morning on a grassy hillside overlooking the valley: a newly built stone grave.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trước khi về phố, Lâm quay lại gian chính thu dọn hành lý bên chiếc gương đồng cổ nay đã sáng bóng nắng mai.
beats: @Lam buckles his leather camera satchel beside the wooden table in the sunlit main hall.
Returning to the bright ancestral main hall to pack his leather camera bag before heading back to the city, @Lam pauses before the antique bronze mirror, now uncovered and gleaming in warm sunlight.
@Lam stands before the uncovered, gleaming bronze mirror reflecting the bright morning room.
clips.sfx: a leather satchel buckle, warm sunny hall ambience
clips.setting: Morning sunlight in the ironwood main hall with the antique bronze mirror, now uncovered.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đúng khoảnh khắc Lâm khoác túi quay lưng bước đi, trên mặt gương đồng phía sau bỗng hiện lên dấu bàn tay vẫy chào.
beats: Over @Lam's shoulder as he turns away from the polished bronze mirror toward the doorway.

Just as @Lam slings his camera bag over his shoulder and turns toward the front door, a soft mist of condensation blooms on the bronze mirror behind him, forming a small, gentle handprint waving farewell.
On the bronze mirror surface, a delicate condensation handprint appears briefly then fades.
clips.sfx: a faint hiss of mist forming on the bronze, a brief warm chime
clips.setting: Morning sunlight in the ironwood main hall with the antique bronze mirror, now uncovered.

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Hãy yên nghỉ thanh thản nơi chín suối nhé cô Út, tạm biệt cô, tôi trở về thành phố đây.
beats: @Lam pauses at the sunlit wooden doorway and turns his head back toward the bronze mirror.
@Lam pauses at the sunlit wooden threshold, looks back over his shoulder at the gleaming bronze mirror with a gentle, respectful smile, and speaks softly before stepping outside.
@Lam bows his head slightly in farewell and steps out onto the bright veranda.
clips.sfx: birdsong in the sunny courtyard
clips.setting: Morning sunlight at the wooden doorway of the main hall, the bright veranda beyond.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tiếng gõ lúc ba giờ sáng đã vĩnh viễn khép lại, để lại bài học nhân quả sâu sắc muôn đời nơi cõi nhân gian.
beats: @Lam walks across the sunlit brick courtyard past the open laterite stone well.
The camera pulls back slowly across the sunlit courtyard past the open, clear-water laterite well and through the mossy stone archway gate as @Lam walks away down the peaceful hillside path.
Wide pull-back through the mossy stone archway gate as @Lam walks down the sunlit hill path.
clips.sfx: footsteps fading down the sunny hill path, a village temple bell ringing
clips.setting: Sunny morning: the courtyard, the open clear-water well and the mossy stone archway gate, a hill path beyond.
